entries.title: Psalms 142:1
segments: <<Maschil of David, when he was in the cave; a Prayer.>> I cry with my voice unto Jehovah; With my voice unto Jehovah do I make supplication.

entries.title: Psalms 142:2
segments: I pour out my complaint before him; I show before him my trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 142:3
segments: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, Thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walk Have they hidden a snare for me.

entries.title: Psalms 142:4
segments: Look on [my] right hand, and see; For there is no man that knoweth me: Refuge hath failed me; No man careth for my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 142:5
segments: I cried unto thee, O Jehovah; I said, Thou art my refuge, My portion in the land of the living.

entries.title: Psalms 142:6
segments: Attend unto my cry; For I am brought very low: Deliver me from my persecutors; For they are stronger than I.

entries.title: Psalms 142:7
segments: Bring my soul out of prison, That I may give thanks unto thy name: The righteous shall compass me about; For thou wilt deal bountifully with me.
